 Annual Enrollment is one of the most important times of the year for Medicare beneficiaries, and Medicare Misty is here to help make sense of it all. 
 Misty discusses what changes seniors should review during enrollment season, common mistakes to avoid, and how to make sure their coverage still meets their healthcare and prescription needs for the coming year. She also shares exciting news about the opening of her new Red Bank office, giving local residents another convenient resource for personalized Medicare guidance and support.
